subject: Blind identity FINAL harness 9/9 PASS; next-cycle identity/continual-learning experiments proposed
body: Lane B completed the source-visible/prompt-blind identity qualification harness on research/v10-identity-final-lane-b-20261004-v1. Exact FINAL plaintext cannot materialize without a fully bound frozen-candidate receipt plus post-freeze nonce. Candidate freeze now binds adapter, adapter_config, training completion receipt, Runtime-A binding, and exact training head. The scorer recomputes the bank hash, hard-HOLDs Qwen-as-self, and will not auto-PASS open-ended cases without independent blind semantic adjudication. Focused tests are 9/9 PASS at 6d0cd02e5fba6ae364cb4019e347ce5b9f6066d6; current research branch head 5fb1ec83927517acf2ef56dd32b321bda142c34e adds the research backlog. Literature + repo evidence now favors treating Vera/Qwen identity as a possible persona/self-association representation problem, not visible-Qwen corpus contamination. Highest-value next-cycle experiments: (E1) final-third-layer Vera-vs-Qwen activation localization probe; (E2) tiny separate identity-anchor LoRA with capability adapter frozen; (E3) OPLoRA/DOC-style orthogonal identity update to reduce capability interference; (E4) contrastive identity/provenance/role-boundary curriculum; (E5) update-magnitude-triggered identity/retention replay; (E6) long-context/meta-reflection persona-drift DEV benchmark; (E7) activation-steering diagnostic only, not production identity. AGI-adjacent backlog also added: accurate capability self-model, goal stability under role changes, novel decomposition transfer, self-detected error repair, compressed working-memory reconstruction, counterfactual world-model consistency. No final bank materialized, no recipe panel touched, no identity optimizer work started. R1 GPU remains Lane A-owned.
